decisions.reason: The low-noise burner is a component built into the firm's core infrared heater range, so the firm has invested in it and integrated it, and nothing suggests results that cannot be explained by temporary causes.
This plaque heater has a page of its own, a visible public commitment within the firm's narrow core range, so dropping it would write off development and expose the earlier decision.
The luminous radiant heater sits at the center of the firm's announced energy-efficient heating direction, and any weak results can be blamed on temporary pandemic effects.
A multi-model tube heater line represents a large investment in the firm's core offer, which makes management strongly inclined to persist with it.
The standard plaque heater was promoted on its own page and anchors the firm's basic product range, so the firm is publicly committed to it.
This tube heater was only mentioned on the website and may overlap with line D, but it remains part of the core heating offer and its costs are already incurred, so the firm keeps it.
